qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the oil filter drain plug hollow bolt?
qa_pairs.answer: The hollow bolt for the oil filter drain plug (4AZ) should be torqued to 20 Nm using an M21/S38 screw type.

qa_pairs.question: What torque value should be applied to the solid aluminum screw on the oil filter drain plug?
qa_pairs.answer: The solid aluminum screw should be torqued to 10 Nm using an M21 screw type.

qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the full length screw in threaded insert on the oil filter drain plug?
qa_pairs.answer: The full length screw in threaded insert should be torqued to 23 Nm using an M21 screw type.

qa_pairs.question: What torque value is specified for the oil drain line on oil filter and upper section of oil pan banjo bolt?
qa_pairs.answer: The oil drain line banjo bolt (5AZ) should be torqued to 30 Nm using screw types M60/1/M60/2/M62/M70/S70/M73.

qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the oil line to bearing points and camshaft lubrication?
qa_pairs.answer: The oil line to bearing points and camshaft lubrication (6AZ) should be torqued to 10 Nm using an M6 screw for all types.

qa_pairs.question: What torque value should be applied to the hollow bolt for the oil line for camshaft lubrication on cylinder head?
qa_pairs.answer: The hollow bolt for the oil line for camshaft lubrication on cylinder head (7AZ) should be torqued to 10 Nm using an M8x1 screw for all types.

qa_pairs.question: Which section of the manual does this page cover?
qa_pairs.answer: This page covers section 11 42 Oil Filter and Pipes under chapter 11 - 28 Engine.

qa_pairs.question: What screw types are specified for the oil drain line banjo bolt?
qa_pairs.answer: The oil drain line banjo bolt uses M60/1/M60/2/M62/M70/S70/M73 screw types.
